songs.title: What Do You Want to Be? 🚒
lines: What do you want to be? Let's see!
A dentist, a soldier, a filmmaker — me!
An architect designs buildings, big and small!
Firefighters fight fires, they answer the call!
Which job do you want to have?
A police officer or a filmmaker?
What does a guidance counselor do?
She helps you find the right job!
n: 곡조: Rap chant (4 beats) — 멜로디 없이 4박으로 읊는 챈트, 가사는 이 단원 낱말로 새로 지었습니다
직업 이름이 나올 때마다 그 직업 동작(카메라 찍기, 소방 호스 잡기, 경례 등)을 하고, 질문 줄에서는 화면을 가리킵니다.
songs.imgPrompt: Children dressed as a dentist, a soldier, a filmmaker with a camera, an architect with building plans, and a firefighter holding a hose.

songs.title: If I Have Skills 💻
lines: If I have computer skills,
Then I will be a programmer!
If the weather is fine today,
I will go to the training — hooray!
An architect needs creative skills
Because he designs new buildings!
A dentist needs patience, too,
Because some patients are really scared!
n: 곡조: Clap chant (4 beats) — 멜로디 없이 4박으로 읊는 챈트, 가사는 이 단원 낱말로 새로 지었습니다
‘If …’ 줄에서는 손가락 하나를 들고, ‘I will …’ 줄에서는 주먹을 쥐고 앞으로 내밀며 4박 박수로 챈트합니다.
songs.imgPrompt: A child typing happily on a computer, children walking to training on a sunny day, an architect drawing a building, and a gentle dentist calming a nervous patient.

songs.title: So I Want to Be… 🔬
lines: I want to be a scientist
Because I like experiments.
I like experiments, so
I'll be a scientist!
I'll be a firefighter, so
I need great physical strength.
I'll be an architect, but I
Don't have creative skills yet!
n: 곡조: The Muffin Man (저작권 만료 곡) — 가사는 이 단원 낱말로 새로 지었습니다
‘so’에서 오른손을 앞으로 쭉 밀고, ‘but’에서 손바닥을 멈춤 표시로 들며, ‘scientist’에서는 비커 흔드는 흉내를 냅니다.
songs.imgPrompt: A child scientist doing a colorful experiment, a strong child firefighter lifting a hose, and a child architect sketching a building plan.
